public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int s = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        long t = scanner.nextLong();

        while (t % n != 0) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (int) ((s + t) % n);
            } else {
                s = (int) ((s - t) % n);
                if (s < 0) s += n;
            }
            t--;
        }
        t /= n;
        int[] seen = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            seen[i] = -1;
        }
        seen[s] = 0;
        int count = 0;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            count++;
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
                if (s < m) {
                    s = (s + i) % n;
                } else {
                    s = (s - i + n) % n;
                }
            }
            if (seen[s] != -1) {
                t %= (count - seen[s]);
            }
            seen[s] = count;
        }
        System.out.println(s + 1);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
